description: sectionproperties is a Python package for finite-element analysis of arbitrary structural cross-sections. The JOSS article describes geometric and warping properties and stresses under combined loads; the own repository provides the package and MIT licence. Spatial coverage is a supplied beam or member section, while temporal coverage belongs to the subsequent structural load case. Section stiffness and stress results can feed building or bridge member simulations. A caveat is that cross-section properties do not capture all system-level load paths, connections, deterioration or buckling. Material properties and meshing require checking for a real component. The tool combines preparation, analysis and plotting but does not approve a structural design. No directly related catalogue record was established. The article and own repository were read without analysing a section.
